name: DataAgent
author: Artistudio

sections.description:
🧠 Meet DataAgent: Turn Your Data Into Decisions

Running a WordPress site or WooCommerce store means you’re sitting on a goldmine of data. The challenge? That data is often messy, hidden in spreadsheets, or buried across different dashboards. Instead of empowering you, it slows you down. That’s where DataAgent comes in.

From Raw Data to Real Insights

DataAgent is an AI-powered solution designed to transform your raw numbers into actionable business intelligence. Instead of guessing what to do next, you’ll know:

  • Uncover hidden sales patterns: Identify which products are driving revenue and why.
  • Spot emerging trends: Anticipate what your customers want before they even ask.
  • Track engagement effortlessly: Understand which blog posts, campaigns, or coupons are really moving the needle.

Smart Decisions Without the Complexity

You don’t need to be a data scientist to make data-driven choices. DataAgent makes analytics simple:

  • Get instant answers to business-critical questions
    • What’s my best-selling product this quarter?
    • Which discount code is actually working?
  • Replace hours of manual analysis with a quick AI-powered conversation.
  • Make confident decisions backed by insights, not guesswork.

Chat With Your Data

One of DataAgent’s most powerful features is the ability to literally “chat with your data.”

  • Use your favorite AI providers (OpenAI, Ollama, OpenRouter) directly from your WordPress admin dashboard.
  • Ask natural-language questions about your sales, products, or audience—get clear, human-like responses.
  • No complicated dashboards. No overwhelming charts. Just a straightforward conversation with your business data.

Seamless Integration With WordPress & WooCommerce

DataAgent plugs right into the tools you already use. Whether you’re managing blog content, running an e-commerce store, or juggling both, it’s designed to work where you work—without forcing you to learn another complex system.

Why DataAgent?

Because running a business should be about growing—not drowning in spreadsheets. With DataAgent, you can:

  • Save hours of manual data crunching.
  • Stay ahead of competitors by spotting trends faster.
  • Focus on scaling your business while DataAgent does the heavy lifting.

DataAgent and AI Service Integration

DataAgent is a WordPress plugin that seamlessly connects your website to leading AI services—including OpenAI, Ollama, and OpenRouter. To use these services, you’ll need to provide your own API keys and comply with the terms and policies of each provider.

For example, if you choose OpenAI:

  • Review their Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
  • Monitor your usage directly through the OpenAI usage dashboard.

We strongly recommend doing the same for Ollama and OpenRouter by reviewing their documentation, usage limits, and policies to ensure compliance.

How Your Data Is Used

When you use DataAgent to chat with your WooCommerce store data, we securely transmit a limited, predefined set of product information to the AI provider you’ve configured. This includes:

WordPress:

  • Post Title
  • Post Content
  • Post Date

WooCommerce:

  • Product Name
  • Product Description
  • Product Price
  • Product Regular Price
  • Product Sale Price
  • Total Sold
  • Total Revenue
  • Units Sold This Month
  • Stock Quantity
  • Categories
  • Tags

Privacy & Control

  • User-initiated only: Data is sent exclusively when you start a chatting.
  • Minimal scope: Only the product fields listed above are transmitted—nothing more.
  • Your choice of AI: You decide whether to use OpenAI, Ollama, or OpenRouter, and you remain in full control of your API keys and account.

By design, DataAgent ensures that your store data stays private, controlled, and only processed when you explicitly engage with the AI service.

Disclaimer

The developer of DataAgent and related parties are not responsible for any issues or losses caused by using the plugin or AI-generated content. You should talk to a legal expert and follow the laws and regulations of your country. DataAgent does only store data on your own server, and it is your responsibility to keep it safe.
sections.installation:
Instruction :

  • You can install the plugin from the WordPress Plugin Repositories or
  • Download the plugin and extract the zip file and just drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation
  • Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  • Select AI Provider & Setup API Key Admin > DataAgent > Settings
  • Start chatting by going to Admin > DataAgent
